name: ui-floor
description: The lines of vstack's design floor that a script can see broken on a rendered page, at desktop and phone width: emoji as icons, dead black, low contrast, and clipped or off-screen elements. Never cached.

verbs.name: check
verbs.description: Load a page at 1280 and 390 pixels wide in headless Chromium, wait for its network to go idle, and list each element that breaks a floor line. Prints a summary per line, or every finding with --json.

url.description: The page to check, such as a local dev server route or a file URL.
